These support məcri/mačhri, mācəli/mācaḷ/mātsalu/macalu and Kullu matʃəɭi. Use the existing l-extension node 9758-3, not the separate ll-extension cited for Gujarati. Local vowel and liquid developments and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. Exact response: matʃəɭi.
